is_anopheles.evidence: The study was conducted using Anopheles coluzzii mosquitoes (page 2, 'The Anopheles coluzzii strain from the Kou Valley (11°24′N, 4°24′59′′W) was used in all experiments').

reports_target_markers.evidence: No target resistance markers were genotyped. The knockdown resistance gene (kdr) is only mentioned as a known characteristic of the laboratory colony citing previous literature (page 2, 'This mosquito strain exhibits metabolic resistance mediated by cytochrome P450 and target-site resistance mediated by the knockdown resistance gene (kdr) [40]').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts or frequencies for any insecticide resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study only evaluated an established colonized laboratory strain, not field-caught mosquitoes or F1 progeny (page 2 and page 6: 'First, the mosquitoes used originated from a single laboratory strain with a high level of insecticide resistance and were reared under controlled conditions').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original primary laboratory experimental study testing the effect of caffeine diets on insecticide resistance and malaria infection.

sub_country_location.evidence: Origin of the colony strain is noted as Kou Valley, Burkina Faso (11°24′N, 4°24′59′′W; page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No collection dates or years are provided for when the laboratory strain was maintained or established, only submission dates in 2025.

duplicate_risk.evidence: No mosquito resistance surveillance dataset overlap; this is a laboratory experimental study.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files consist of raw mortality and knockdown data and statistical analysis scripts; no marker genotyping was performed.

assessment.summary: This laboratory study investigates the effect of caffeine-supplemented diet on deltamethrin resistance and longevity in Plasmodium falciparum-infected and uninfected Anopheles coluzzii using a colonized laboratory strain (VK5/Kou Valley). No insecticide resistance marker genotyping was performed.
exclusion_reasons: No target resistance markers were genotyped.
No extractable resistance marker genotype data are reported.
Mosquitoes tested were from an established laboratory colony rather than an African field population.
